say:1:1033421001:1.text: Thank you for your kind words, outsider.
say:1:1033421001:1.male: Thank you for your kind words, outsider.
say:1:1033421001:1.female: Thank you for your kind words, outsider.

say:2:1033421002:1.text: But Eomir did use us as his weapon.
say:2:1033421002:1.source_cn: 可我们确实成为了伊米尔手中的武器。
say:2:1033421002:1.male: But Eomir did use us as his weapon.
say:2:1033421002:1.female: But Eomir did use us as his weapon.

say:3:1033421003:1.text: A weapon is used however the hand wants because it has no intelligence.
say:3:1033421003:1.source_cn: 武器被利用，是因为它们本就没有思想。
say:3:1033421003:1.male: A weapon is used however the hand wants because it has no intelligence.
say:3:1033421003:1.female: A weapon is used however the hand wants because it has no intelligence.

say:4:1033421004:1.text: As Thorned Guards, we are supposed to be able to discern, but we didn't...
say:4:1033421004:1.source_cn: 身为荆棘的我们拥有思想，本该明辨，却还是……唉。
say:4:1033421004:1.male: As Thorned Guards, we are supposed to be able to discern, but we didn't...
say:4:1033421004:1.female: As Thorned Guards, we are supposed to be able to discern, but we didn't...
